messages:
maria gonzalez: opening thread for Seabright customer postmortem follow-ups. Incident recap: VPC peering session dropped during a rolling maintenance window, control-plane timeouts, and tenant-level isolation observed. compiling action items + owners. please ack or claim.

kevin li: i'll own the peering teardown race fix. reproduced locally in a stress harness. aiming for a PR by 2025-01-21. will add unit and integration tests.

tanvi patel: i'll build the onprem network fuzz harness to simulate WAN jitter and asymmetric routing. target: prototype by 2025-01-25, CI integration the week after.

phil ward: will add the asymmetric-route detector alert and a dashboard panel for "peering flap delta". hope to have alert+runbook link by 2025-01-23.

amanda chen: exploring short-term mitigation: auto-route-split to fallback gateway model when peering health degrades > 30s. i can draft a config-safe proposal by 2025-01-28.

ops-bot: New ticket created: SRE-8520 (Seabright peering followups). URL: https://jira.internal/SRE-8520

jonathan park: i'll take runbook updates: "Seabright isolation triage" with checklist for oncall and escalation matrix. ETA 2025-02-06. also propose monthly regression check.

maria gonzalez: suggested order: code patch -> harness -> monitoring -> mitigation design -> runbook. target completion window: 2025-02-14. any blockers?

kevin li: no blockers on my side. PR will request two reviewers. tagging @phil and @jonathan park for quick turnaround.

phil ward: on review queue for kevin's PR. also please add a dedicated integ test into the dedicated CI pipeline to catch peering teardown races.

tanvi patel: naming suggestion for CI job: onprem-peering-fuzz. i'll add to eng-platform CI matrix and open PR.

maria gonzalez: action tracker (please copy to SRE-8520 comments):
```
- Owner: kevin li | Action: fix peering teardown race + test | ETA: 2025-01-21 | Ticket: SRE-8520-1
- Owner: tanvi patel | Action: onprem network fuzz harness + CI job | ETA: 2025-01-25 | Ticket: SRE-8520-2
- Owner: phil ward | Action: asymmetric-route alert + dashboard | ETA: 2025-01-23 | Ticket: SRE-8520-3
- Owner: amanda chen | Action: gateway-fallback mitigation design | ETA: 2025-01-28 | Ticket: SRE-8520-4
- Owner: jonathan park | Action: isolation triage runbook + escalation | ETA: 2025-02-06 | Ticket: SRE-8520-5
```

kevin li: :thumbsup: added to PR and ticket. will include logs snippet showing the race condition.

amanda chen: please include a post-deploy smoke check: 3 small requests across peering boundary to verify KV cache consistency. i'll add to the mitigation design.

jonathan park: proposal: if tenant isolation pattern (peering flap -> control-plane timeout -> >1 tenant error spike) occurs twice within 90 days, auto-escalate to infra lead + security and open a cross-team incident review. thoughts?

maria gonzalez: agree. can we set an alert threshold and a playbook action?

phil ward: yes. i'll add a regression alert rule and a simple webhook that creates SRE-incident review tickets when threshold met.

ops-bot: Calendar invite scheduled: Seabright postmortem follow-up retro 2025-01-29 09:00 PT. Invitees: participants.

tanvi patel: i'll surface these metrics on the dashboard: peering flap count, median reconnection time, tenant error-rate, KV divergence rate. will attach sample graphs to SRE-8520.

maria gonzalez: perfect. i'll update SRE-8520 with this thread and close the loop on owners. if timelines slip, flag in-thread and update ticket. thanks all.
